key_findings: CRISPR/Cas9 knockdown of NRP-1 in rat DRG neurons abolished VEGFA-induced potentiation of NaV1.7 sodium currents and CaV2.2 calcium currents, and VEGFA-induced increases in dorsal horn sEPSC frequency, without affecting potassium channels.
Intrathecal NRP-1 gRNA/Cas9 lentivirus reversed spinal nerve ligation-induced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in male and female rats.
